title: Yogurt-Sour Shawarma Wrap
description: A tangy twist on the classic Middle Eastern shawarma, featuring a crispy pita and a refreshing yogurt-sour sauce.

ingredients.name: Lavash Bread
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of flatbread, but lavash is traditional.

ingredients.name: Yogurt
ingredients.notes: Plain, full-fat yogurt is best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince them finely for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh parsley adds a lot of flavor.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.notes: Slice it thinly for best results.

ingredients.name: Red Onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice it and soak it in cold water for 10 minutes to remove some of the pungency.

ingredients.name: Unsalted Pistachios
ingredients.notes: Chopped pistachios add crunch and flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use as needed to bring out the flavors.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Brush the pita with a little olive oil before toasting it for best flavor.

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Toast the lavash bread for about 30 seconds on each side, until it's crispy and slightly charred.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and parsley.
Add the chopped cucumber and red onion to the yogurt mixture and stir to combine.
Spread a tablespoon or two of the yogurt-sour sauce on each toasted lavash bread.
Top each bread with some chopped pistachios and a slice or two of cucumber.
Drizzle with a little olive oil and serve immediately.
Serve the yogurt-sour shawarma wrap with additional yogurt-sour sauce on the side, if desired.
